propositions: Below-seam ambient config and credential reads in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py violate the approved composition-root seam boundary and must be routed through owned resolvers
Three new composition-root resolvers (mcp_gate, compose_config, read_secret_env) are added to config.py to legitimately own MCP config/secret reads at the boundary

MCP consumers in mcp_server.py L422/591/735/646 and _mcp_auth.py L411/658/760 must be refactored to receive composed config/secret values from config.py resolvers instead of calling load_config() or os.environ.get() directly
LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be removed and check_config_ownership.py must report zero findings for these paths
Per-request resolution semantics and secret handling must be preserved with no behavioral delta; existing subsystem test suites must remain green after the cutover
